statements.status_notes: OSS fix is micrometer-core 1.15.12 or 1.16.6. Stargate 1.0.x and 2.0.x build on Java 8 with Dropwizard 2.x, which pins micrometer-core 1.8.2 via micrometer.version. The 1.9.x backport (1.9.18) is VMware Tanzu Enterprise only and is not published to Maven Central. A cross-line bump to 1.15.x has not been validated here because the Maven build requires cloudsmith-central credentials unavailable in this sandbox.
